banner.png.how: Composed in HTML (source/banner.html) and rendered with headless Chrome: a 1920x987 window (its page area is 87 px shorter), cropped to 1920x900 from the top.
banner.png.screensAre: Unchanged captures of the production app at 375x812 (2x), 2026-10-23: event.jpg and terminal.jpg from mitoshi.xyz and its workers.dev address, order.jpg earlier the same day. Prices and odds are live public market data; no wallet was funded and no order was sent.
banner.png.words: The landing hero (apps/web/src/features/landing/copy.ts), re-rendered on 2026-10-28 for the new hero line; the phone screens are the 2026-10-23 captures.

demo-cover.png.how: Composed in HTML (source/demo-cover.html) and rendered with headless Chrome at a 1920x1080 viewport.
demo-cover.png.note: Artwork with a play button that links to /demo. It is not a recording, and it shows no transaction.

apps/web/public/demo/still.webp.how: source/demo-cover.html#still (the cover without the play button), rendered at 1920x1080 and resized to 1280x720.
apps/web/public/demo/still.webp.note: Shown on /demo while the recording does not exist, so nothing there looks playable that isn't.

apps/web/public/demo/cover.webp.note: The cover /demo links out from once DEMO_VIDEO_URL is set.

apps/web/public/og.png.how: source/banner.html#og rendered the same way at 1920x1008, then scaled to 1200x630.
apps/web/public/og.png.note: The link preview; the same words and screens as banner.png.

logo-512.png.how: apps/web/src/app/icon.svg rendered at 512x512 the same way.
